_comment: The five mandated breakpoints. 1099 and 1100 straddle the custom min-[1100px] desktop-nav breakpoint (Navbar swaps mobile hamburger + bottom tab bar for the full desktop nav, and h-32->h-16 scroll-shrink kicks in) — both are captured so the regression suite catches a one-pixel breakpoint drift. Height is a fixed initial viewport; full-page screenshots expand beyond it.

viewports.note: just below the 1100px nav breakpoint -> mobile nav
at the breakpoint -> desktop nav engages
